sanitization: Whitelist accounting, original session/message/response/call identities, timestamps, sequence numbers and references, model/provider identifiers, and format version; replace cwd only. Remove content, arguments, results, request headers, and unrelated records.
reasoning_evidence: versioned-writer alternative; the live capture has no separate reasoning counter. TestRC6WriterReasoningSubset is explicitly a constructed edge.

writer_files.evidence: Captured Pi provider path folds reasoning into output; it emits input/output and nonzero cache buckets without an explicit reasoning counter.
Versioned alternate provider maps completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens to reasoningTokens while retaining completion_tokens as outputTokens, then emits the mapped usage chunk.
Assembler preserves the complete usage object from the provider chunk.
TokenUsage requires inputTokens/outputTokens; cache and reasoning counters are optional.
Agent appends each provider chunk, feeds the assembler, and writes its unchanged usage to assistant/message when defined, with sourceEventSeqs.
Durable JSONL serializes complete event objects; default compression stores the same logical records in concatenated zstd frames.
Token meter explicitly excludes reasoning from the input+cacheRead+cacheWrite+output total to avoid double counting reasoning output.
